benchmarks.description: Return-only baseline
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures the staged harness floor for baseline subtraction
benchmarks.name: simple

benchmarks.description: Packet-backed return-only baseline
benchmarks.hypothesis: Removes staged input helper overhead to expose the packet-backed harness floor
benchmarks.name: simple_packet

benchmarks.description: Bitmap popcount scan over generated u64 words
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents bitmap/set summarization loops common in BPF policy and tracing code
benchmarks.name: bitmap_popcount_scan

benchmarks.description: Repeated lookup over a sorted rule table
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures verifier-friendly bounded rule lookup without map/helper dependencies
benchmarks.name: sorted_rule_binary_search

benchmarks.description: bcc runqlat-style log2 latency bucket selection with clamp
benchmarks.hypothesis: Mirrors tracing histogram bucket selection without helper/map updates
benchmarks.name: bcc_runqlat_log2_histogram_bucket

benchmarks.description: Trace event type dispatch over generated 6-bit event IDs
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents event/type dispatch tables seen in tracing filters
benchmarks.name: trace_event_type_switch_dispatch

benchmarks.description: Internet checksum style packet reduction
benchmarks.hypothesis: Sequential 16-bit reductions should emphasize scalar memory throughput
benchmarks.name: packet_checksum_fold

benchmarks.description: Payload prefix comparison over fixed-size candidate records
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents protocol/string prefix filters with early mismatch exits
benchmarks.name: payload_prefix_memcmp_scan

benchmarks.description: Packet-backed Ethernet plus VLAN plus IPv4 plus TCP parser with options walk
benchmarks.hypothesis: Variable cursor advancement and repeated bounds checks should magnify packet-parse codegen differences
benchmarks.name: packet_vlan_tcpopt_parser

benchmarks.description: Dispatch among four __noinline local subprograms with different pressure profiles
benchmarks.hypothesis: Fan-out local calls should stress call-site layout, prologue diversity, and join-point register allocation
benchmarks.name: bpf_local_call_fanout_dispatch

benchmarks.description: Parse an IPv4 TCP 5-tuple and compute a Jenkins-style flow hash
benchmarks.hypothesis: Endian conversion plus field extraction and rotates should be more workload-realistic than standalone checksum math
benchmarks.name: flow_5tuple_rss_hash

benchmarks.description: Katran IPv4 TCP VIP path with local fixture lookups and consistent-hash backend selection
benchmarks.hypothesis: A helper-free Katran-shaped path should expose realistic parse, hash, selection, and encap ALU patterns
benchmarks.name: katran_lb_consistent_hash_select

benchmarks.description: Cilium-policy-shaped nested guard tree over staged record fields
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents policy/filter decision trees without map/helper dependencies
benchmarks.name: cilium_policy_guard_tree_filter

benchmarks.description: SipHash-like hash mixer using 64-bit rotations
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures a realistic rotate-heavy hash mixer used by packet and map-key paths
benchmarks.name: siphash_rotate64_mixer

benchmarks.description: Packet-backed record parser with one wide dominating window plus many redundant sub-checks
benchmarks.hypothesis: Dominating range checks should create a clean target for redundant bounds-check elimination
benchmarks.name: packet_record_bounds_window

benchmarks.description: Dense fixed-offset field extraction from flow-like records
benchmarks.hypothesis: Many same-base fixed-offset loads should reward base-plus-offset fusion and grouped field lowering
benchmarks.name: flow_record_field_scan

benchmarks.description: Packed header bitfield extraction over staged two-word records
benchmarks.hypothesis: Repeated constant shift-and-mask extracts should reward compact canonical extract lowering over packed inputs
benchmarks.name: packed_header_bitfield_decode

benchmarks.description: bpftrace-style bounded string length and substring prefix scan
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents helper-free string fallback paths with bounded byte loops
benchmarks.name: bpftrace_string_search_prefix_scan

benchmarks.description: Tracee-style sparse syscall number to name-table dispatch
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents sparse syscall lookup and name classification without map/helper dependencies
benchmarks.name: tracee_syscall_name_table_lookup

benchmarks.description: Tracee net_l7_is_http-style HTTP method prefix detection
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents protocol prefix chains over packet/string bytes
benchmarks.name: tracee_http_method_prefix_detect

benchmarks.description: Cilium socket LB service selection over protocol, port range, wildcard, and backend count
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures protocol/port/range/wildcard decision trees plus backend selection math
benchmarks.name: cilium_socket_lb_service_select

benchmarks.description: bcc tcpconnect-style IPv4 tuple event filter over pid, uid, netns, and port class
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures tracing event tuple filtering without packet parsing, maps, or helpers
benchmarks.name: bcc_tcpconnect_ipv4_tuple_filter

benchmarks.description: Tetragon process-event argument, namespace, capability, and action filter
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents security policy event filtering over process metadata and argument signatures
benchmarks.name: tetragon_process_event_arg_filter

benchmarks.description: OpenTelemetry profiler-style stack frame unwind scan over frame deltas and symbol hashes
benchmarks.hypothesis: Captures profiler unwind cursor updates and frame classification without helper dependencies
benchmarks.name: otel_stack_frame_unwind_scan

benchmarks.description: Cilium conntrack/NAT tuple rewrite with direction swap, rev NAT id, identity, and lifetime fields
benchmarks.hypothesis: Represents datapath tuple rewrite and CT/NAT metadata mixing distinct from service selection
benchmarks.name: cilium_ct_nat_tuple_rewrite

benchmarks.description: Packet-backed IPv4 TCP Toeplitz RSS hash over a 5-tuple
benchmarks.hypothesis: Adds NIC/RSS-style Toeplitz hashing, a different packet hash family from Jenkins and SipHash-like mixers
benchmarks.name: packet_toeplitz_rss_hash

benchmarks.description: bpftrace-style comm plus pid/tgid/probe aggregation key hashed with FNV-1a
benchmarks.hypothesis: Adds lightweight string/tuple aggregation key hashing distinct from packet-oriented hash paths
benchmarks.name: bpftrace_comm_key_fnv_hash

benchmarks.description: TC version of the packet checksum fold benchmark
benchmarks.hypothesis: Reuses the checksum reduction under a sched_cls hook with packet-fed staged input and skb-context result extraction
benchmarks.name: tc_packet_checksum_fold

benchmarks.description: cgroup_skb egress hash-chain reduction over generated u64 words
benchmarks.hypothesis: Exercises a non-XDP cgroup_skb hook with packet-fed staged input and skb-context result extraction
benchmarks.name: cgroup_skb_hash_chain
